sql_templates.description: Retrieve the latest insider alerts and matching bulk or block deals with technical confirmation.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, ia.insider_score, bb.deal_date, bb.qty, ss.stage, ss.trading_signal, ss.technical_score
FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals bb ON ia.symbol = bb.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ia.alert_date = (SELECT MAX(alert_date) FROM signals.insider_alerts)
AND bb.deal_date = (SELECT MAX(deal_date) FROM signals.bulk_block_deals)
AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.technical_score DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Fetches resolved signals from past month showing respective stage and score context.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT
    sl.symbol,
    sl.company,
    sl.signal,
    sl.date_issued,
    sl.date_resolved,
    sl.price_at_resolution,
    sl.return_pct,
    sl.hit_target,
    sl.hit_stop,
    st.stage,
    st.technical_score,
    st.investment_score
FROM
    signals.signal_log sl
JOIN
    scores.stage_snapshots st ON sl.symbol = st.symbol
WHERE
    sl.date_resolved IS NOT NULL
    AND sl.date_issued > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'
ORDER BY
    sl.date_issued DESC
LIMIT 100;
